segments.name: Nitrogen Fertilizer
segments.description: Produces and distributes nitrogen fertilizer products, ammonia, UAN and nitric acid, sold wholesale to farmers, retailers, distributors and industrial customers in the United States.
segments.evidence: CVR Partners has one operating and reportable segment: Nitrogen Fertilizer.

revenueModel.text: Farmers, retailers, distributors and industrial customers pay wholesale prices for nitrogen fertilizer products, mainly UAN and ammonia, under contracts or purchase orders.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily market UAN products to agricultural customers and ammonia products to agricultural and industrial customers.
